status: FROZEN. Do not edit. Definition changes to the v2 rule are proposed as v4, not here.
source: Bryan via miro, 2026-10-30: v2 entry/skip PLUS size caps; backtest reference hawse-research/kalshi-15m-capacity-10k.md and hawse-research/kalshi-15m/capacity/. UNPROVEN.

base.entry: identical to v2: v3 trades exactly the v1 signals that v2 decides 'take' (same market, same book, same time); 'skip' and 'unknown' are not traded. v3 never re-decides. Kalshi's official result comes from v1's settle row.

sizing.balance: each line has its own paper balance and ledger; the balance compounds from settled P&L only (open positions do not count)
sizing.contracts: min( floor(pct * balance / decisionAsk), floor(perAssetCap / decisionAsk), floor(overallCap / decisionAsk) if set, floor(participation * entryMinuteVolume), floor(cash / (decisionAsk + 0.01 + 0.25 * fee rate)) ); cash = balance minus cost and fee reserved by open positions. 'cap bound' = a cap other than the X% line is the smallest (ties count for every cap at the minimum)
sizing.perAssetCapStatus: provisional (XRP is listed but v1 does not trade XRP)

participation.volume: contracts traded (sum of c, Kalshi public trades, both taker sides) with exchange time in the 60 s before the signal book
participation.note: volume counts both sides (YES and NO takers), so this cap is optimistic; the backtest found YES-taker share 41% (27% at 93-98c)
participation.ifZeroVolume: zero contracts; logged with the participation cap as the bound

fill.snapshot: the same next book snapshot v1 fills on (v1 fill row bookRx); no v3 fill when v1 has no fill
fill.visible: walk the recorded YES ask ladder best-first; fill only levels at or below limit = min(0.99, decisionAsk + 0.01)
fill.remainder: contracts above the visible depth within the limit are NOT filled (logged as unfilled). A stress line prices them at min(0.99, worst visible level + 0.01) and flags remainder_priced_worst_plus_1c; the stress line is display only and never enters the balance
fill.slippage: fill VWAP minus decision-time YES ask, in cents

fees.formula: per order: roundup_to_cent(0.07 * sum over fill levels of C_i * P_i * (1 - P_i))

log: book depth at the ask (all recorded levels)

refill.measure: YES ask contracts at or below the fill limit in each later book, plus the best ask

pass.test: same gate as v2 for the edge: one-sided Fisher exact, the skipped group's loss rate is greater than the kept group's (identical to v2 by construction)
pass.keptNet: v3 3pct line: settled P&L per filled contract after the per-order fee, on the take signals in the first-look cohort
pass.label: UNPROVEN until minV1Signals settled v1 signals with a known v2 decision

backtestReference.fillable: probably fillable up to ~$300 per trade on all assets; BTC up to ~$5,000
backtestReference.simPeriod: v2 with the 10% participation cap (of entry-candle volume), Jun-Oct OOS, from $10,000 on Jun 1
backtestReference.caveat: volume counts both sides and is measured in the entry candle while the fill happens a few seconds later; only 16 real markets with a full book, all on one afternoon
